Subject: Nightshift panel reserve and surge pairing for Sophie Chen (final onsite)

Hi team —

We have Sophie Chen (final onsite loop) who is only available in the APAC morning window next week, which maps to late evening / overnight US hours. Candidate availability (UTC): Apr 16, 2027 between 09:30–13:30 UTC (4x 45-min interviews). We need three interviewers (System Design, API/Infra, Behavioral) and one reserve to cover no-shows or overlap.

Ask: can we assemble a night-owl reserve pair and confirm primary coverage? Key constraints:
- Keep any single person to max 2 interviews to avoid burnout.
- Reserve should be able to hop in with <30 min notice.

I've attached Sophie’s resume and a quick availability grid. I can take Behavioral if nobody else volunteers but will be on call earlier that day so ideally I’m reserve-first.

Proposed approach:
1) Volunteers for primary slots (design / infra / behavioral).
2) One dedicated reserve (remote, able to join at short notice) plus calendar invite held for all.
3) If we can’t find internal coverage, loop in recruiter-run backfills (Greenlight) but prefer internal.

Please reply with: "I can take X slot" or "I can reserve" and your timezone offset. We need final lineup by EOD (PST) tomorrow so scheduling can lock the invites.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
